Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aditya - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Pihu - 10 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Kavita - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Rajesh - 41 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
5. Sharda - 62 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it
4. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Aditya stands in the bedroom. Kavita and Sharda stand near him.]

Sharda: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aditya yawns loudly.]

Aditya (excited): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Aditya stretches his arms above his head.]

Aditya: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aditya is sitting on a chair in the living room. Kavita, Rajesh and Pihu stand near him.]

Pihu: "What a nice place."

[Aditya stands up.]

Kavita (softly): "One more time!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Aditya stands by the road. Kavita and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya rides his bicycle down the road.]

Kavita: "Really?"

[Aditya gets into the car.]

Rajesh: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aditya gets on the bus.]

Aditya: "What next?"

[Aditya gets off the school bus.]

Aditya: "Oh wow!"

[Aditya hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Kavita: "Rajesh, listen!"

[Aditya pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Aditya: "That was fun!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

Aditya: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya folds his hands and prays.]

Kavita: "One more time!"

[Aditya lights a diya.]

Aditya (softly): "That's easy."

[Pihu draws a rangoli at the door.]

Aditya (laughing): "Careful!"

[Aditya paints a picture.]

Aditya: "Oh wow!"

[Aditya draws a picture of the house.]

Aditya: "I really enjoyed today."
